why: Same notions (X_C = hC.toMPolyfold hne, d_X = MPolyfold.degIndex, d_C = degIndex E C). A ⇒ B: C is relatively open in itself (V = E₀) and corollary_2_32 at U = C. B ⇒ A fails for a genuine reason on the fourth conjunct degIndexWith_le_of_germ (core of Theorem 2.31): d_C(x) ≤ d_{C'}(F x) for a germ F from a relatively open U₀ ⊆ C onto a RETRACT O' with F and G∘r' only sc¹, at level-1 points; B concerns d_X, defined through sc-SMOOTH charts, of partial quadrants only, and an sc¹ germ is not a chart, so B says nothing about it (with sc-smooth F, G it would follow, F being a chart of X_{U₀}). The other three conjuncts do follow from B (B_to_A123, rt_check OK): A states the corollary for every nonempty relatively open U ⊆ C, and new glue incl_isScDiffeoOn shows X_U ≅ the open piece {c ∈ U} of X_C, so the non-item proposition_2_24 reduces it to B at U = C; degIndex_le and degIndex_le_degIndex_of_lvl1 are the two halves of that equality. No universe parameters.
